newsitem.title: FRANCE: Placement rumours knock Rhone shares.
newsitem.headline: Placement rumours knock Rhone shares.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc shares weakened on Wednesday on rumours that a shareholder was preparing to place some 15 million shares, nearly five percent of the chemicals company's capital, on the market, brokers said.
One portfolio manager said he had been sounded out about such an operation on Tuesday night.
Rhone shares were down 2.3 percent at 166 francs.
Speculation about who the seller might be centred on the state agency CDR, created to group Credit Lyonnais assets to be sold. Rhone-Poulenc and CDR declined comment.
CDR holds around five percent of Rhone-Poulenc.
Du Bouzet, SBC-Warburg and Cholet Dupont were rumoured as possible lead managers in the operation.
